methodologies.label: Waterfall
methodologies.advisory: Waterfall is a poor fit for experimental model work. Expect rework when Model Development cycles invalidate earlier assumptions.

methodologies.label: Scrum
methodologies.description: Time-boxed sprints with backlog and ceremonies
methodologies.advisory: Map Model Development experiments to sprint goals. Treat data blockers as sprint risks, not backlog polish.

methodologies.label: SAFe
methodologies.description: Scaled Agile with PI planning and ART cadence
methodologies.advisory: Put data readiness and EU obligations on the program board. Model experiments belong in innovation and planning iteration capacity.

methodologies.label: Kanban
methodologies.advisory: Use explicit WIP limits on experiment lanes. Hypercare is a permanent swimlane, not a project end date.

methodologies.label: Hybrid
methodologies.description: Mix of stage gates for compliance and agile execution for build
methodologies.advisory: Keep EU and architecture gates sequential. Run Data Engineering and Model Development iteratively inside those gates.

methodologies.label: Custom
methodologies.advisory: Custom keeps the full PRISM phase and task library from your AI recommendation. Ceremony names are unlabelled until you add an org overlay. Prefer Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Hybrid, or Waterfall if you want built-in methodology mapping. Config Centre is optional admin — not required to run a project.
